name: cell-burst
title: Cell burst
description: Seeded square cells bursting from a point: a sheet of cells with some redrawn smaller and smaller down to a vanishing point, each a wedge of hairlines. Jumble scatters it, ledger makes it a spreadsheet's, strong holds up on the red, trace sets the grid redrawing itself. Grain is the texture it sits under.
use_for: The website's illustrations of data being found and processed: the blog cards, How it works, the closing band, a work panel.
never: Running off screen: it draws as the panel nears the screen

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
// The website's grain (home.css .footer-grain): the brand texture tiled at 12% of the panel, laid over a dark or red
// ground at 30%. Decorative; put it first inside a `relative` panel.
</script>

<template>
  <span data-ds="grain" aria-hidden="true" class="ds-grain pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 opacity-30" />
</template>

<style>
.ds-grain { background-image: url("/conare-ds/textures/grain.webp"); background-size: 12% auto; background-repeat: repeat; }
</style>
